title: Gold rate ka confusion
style: Cute, chunky 3D animated characters, soft rounded shapes, family-film style, warm showroom lighting. Use the reference images: the woman is Pinky, the man is Gappu - keep their faces, hair and outfits exactly. Natural, expressive Hindi voices. No subtitles, no on-screen text, no logos, no watermarks.

scenes.prompt: Setting: a bright, warm Indian jewellery showroom with glass counters full of gold necklaces. Gappu excitedly points at a gold necklace in the counter, checks his phone and grins: gold rates are falling. The jeweller, a polite older man with spectacles, quotes a high price. Gappu's eyes pop wide; he looks at his phone, then the jeweller, then his wallet, completely confused, exaggerated cartoon reactions. Gappu says in Hindi: "अरे! सोने का भाव तो गिर रहा है... फिर ये इतना महंगा क्यों?" Pinky gives him a knowing, playful look and says in Hindi: "गप्पू, सिर्फ़ भाव देखना काफ़ी नहीं है!" She takes out her smartphone and holds it towards Gappu, the screen a plain dark screen facing the camera; Gappu leans in, curious. Light comedy music. One continuous shot.

Continue the same scene: same showroom, same positions, same characters and outfits. Pinky holds her smartphone towards Gappu; the screen stays a plain dark screen. Pinky says in Hindi: "अलग-अलग ज्वेलर्स के गोल्ड रेट और मेकिंग चार्जेस compare करो!" Gappu stares at the phone, his eyes sparkle, then he acts like a genius: adjusts imaginary glasses, puffs his chest and nods proudly, saying in Hindi: "अरे वाह! अब होगी असली स्मार्ट शॉपिंग!" Pinky laughs at his over-confidence.

Continue the same scene. Gappu scrolls the phone, nods, then proudly picks up the gold necklace and presents it to Pinky with a little bow. Pinky smiles and kisses his cheek. Gappu blushes bright red and nearly topples over. Cute floating hearts and a funny romantic sound. Gappu says in Hindi: "रेट compare किए... पैसे भी बचाए... अब बीवी भी खुश!" Pinky giggles and hugs him.

end_card.voiceover: सोना खरीदने से पहले, रेट compare करें MyGoldRates.com पर!
